{{Tabs|History = No}} {{SameName|Hallow Guard|[[Hallow Guard (Trick or Threat Town)|Trick or Threat Town]] • [[Hallow Guard (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Null & Void]] • [[Hallow Guard (Unit)|Unit]]}} {{For|the [[Hallow Bones]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Hallow Guard |image-static = HallowGuardLunar1.png |image-dynamic = HallowGuardDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |type= Humanoid |source = [[Necromancer]]
[[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]2,000 |defense = {{Defense}}15% |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]2 |damage_type = Collision |speed = 3.5 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hallow Guard''' is a unit spawned from [[Necromancer]]'s gravestones and randomly from dead enemies while the [[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] consumable is active. It can spawn from Level 2 and 3 gravestones. It is an upgraded version of the [[Giant Skeleton (Unit)|Giant Skeleton]] unit, having higher health than it. It only deals damage through collision. ==Appearance== The '''Hallow Guard''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large flaming blue eyeholes. It wears a brown belt, grey shoulder-pads, crown and a chestplate, which as a black skull with neon blue eyes on it. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:MageHallowGuard.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenHallowGuard.png|175px]] |[[File:DuckHallowGuard.png|175px]] |[[File:CreepySantaHallowGuard.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |{{Color|DuckyRevenge|Duck}} |{{Color|FinalAct|Creepy Santa}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Premium Battle Pass]] |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Regular Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Hallow Guard's''' high health allows it to handle hordes of weaker enemies easily, like the [[Molten]], [[Fallen]] or [[Shock]]. **It can also deal a significant amount of damage to higher health enemies, like the [[Giant Boss]] or [[Slow Boss]]. *The '''Hallow Guard''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Giant Boss]] or [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]]. *The '''Hallow Guard's''' high health allows it to survive most enemy abilities that damage units, like the [[Fallen King]]'s ''Sword Swing'' ability. **However, since its only source of damage is collision, their abilities still reduce the amount of damage it can deal. ==Trivia== *The '''Hallow Guard''' is the [[Hallow Guard (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] enemy from the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2023''' -
